## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and any compatibility or licensing impact.

## Tests

List exact commands and results, including skips or checks not run.

- [ ] Regression tests added or updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] Ruff lint and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] Relevant unit tests and isolated Compose suites pass; omissions explained.
- [ ] CI is green before merge.
- [ ] No credentials, private mail, generated state, or SEL-licensed Stalwart binaries/images included.
- [ ] Each contribution commit has a DCO 1.1 sign-off (`git commit -s`); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
